episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Detective Joon Mo goes undercover within Gangnam Union to probe an international drug trade.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Barely passing Gi Cheul's test, Joon Mo joins Gangnam Union and discovers an unexpected truth.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The team seeks Eui Jung's aid to assist Joon Mo in a crisis, which leads to a perilous love triangle.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The team seeks Eui Jung's aid to assist Joon Mo in a crisis, which leads to a perilous love triangle.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Earning Gi Cheul's trust, Joon Mo becomes anxious as he sees Gi Cheul making a move towards Eui Jung.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The delivery accident jeopardizes the trade. Detective Hwang closely surveils Gangnam Union.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Hae Ryun shows interest in Joon Mo and Eui Jung approaches Gi Cheul. Joon Mo takes an extreme measure.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Gi Cheul suspects Joon Mo. The four people's irreversible decisions trigger the biggest crisis.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: The battle with Jaegeon creates a crack. Joon Mo joins forces with Hae Ryun to resume the trade.

episodes.title: Episode10
episodes.summary: Joon Mo and Eui Jung juggle duty and feelings. Hwang continues to meddle, and the final day arrives.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: An accident halts the trade and a crisis approaches as Eui Jung and Do Hyung worry about Joon Mo.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Gi Cheul and Joon Mo make their way to the final deal. Korea, China, and Japan prepare for the arrest.
